body:
Founder real-time: continue adding to DUNG's parena work, we want to emit go with burrow. emit_go.go: same narrow v0 scope as Phase 4's C target, GC-off-safe by construction, -o *.go on burrow build. Two real bugs found+fixed live via a nested-if probe (I32 literal defaults to int not int32 when boxed through any; a nested if's own result needs a type assertion not a conversion). go/format.Source pass guarantees gofmt-clean output. go test: 48/48. Real end-to-end proof: DUNG's entry.prn compiled to Go and wired directly into cmd/dung/main.go, no cgo/FFI. BURROW commit 1f037cc, DUNG commit 7a24dcf.

⚓ ☃
title: BURROW Phase 6 — real, native Go emission target
